[[File:Leather body detail.png|left|130px]]
'''Leather body''' is a part of [[leather armour]] and is the weakest [[ranged armour|ranged torso]] in the game. It requires 1 [[Ranged]] to equip. By using [[steel studs]] on a leather body, members can turn them into a [[studded body]] at level 41 [[Crafting]].
